subject: Scheduling: 3-part API + Live Demo for Meridian Health (two-day split)
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex@meridianhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: 3-part onboarding + live demo (preferred week of Jun 21)

Hi Rafael and Jordan,

Thanks for the intro call last week. We're excited to progress to a hands-on demo so our infra and analytics teams can validate latency and the end-to-end flow. We'd like a 3-part workshop that covers:
- 30m product overview and deployment options
- 45m API keys, authentication, and quick integration samples
- 90m live lab where we push sample payloads and observe tracing/metrics

Our core constraints: multiple NYC-based engineers (EST) and a small team in Lisbon (WEST). Week of Jun 21 works best for us; mornings EST are preferable for Lisbon overlap.

I've attached a draft agenda (Meridian-Agenda-v1.pdf). Can you confirm availability and whether Redwood needs any network prep (VPN/proxy) for the lab? Also flag any instructor overlap concerns.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Sr. Platform Engineer
Meridian Health

Attachments: Meridian-Agenda-v1.pdf (draft agenda), infrastructure-inventory.xlsx (stub)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>

On Sat, Jun 12, 2027 at 09:12 AM Alex Mercer <alex@meridianhealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Rafael and Jordan,
>
> Thanks for the intro call last week...

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the draft agenda. Two quick notes:
1) To respect everyone's attention span across timezones, we recommend splitting the 3 parts across two days (30m + 45m on day 1, 90m lab on day 2). That reduces context-switching for your Lisbon team.
2) We need sandbox accounts for each developer who will join the live lab and (optionally) a temporary S3 bucket for sample payload ingestion. If your infra team prefers a VPC tunnel, please let us know — Soojin will coordinate network tests.

Availability from our side (all times EST):
- Tue Jun 22: 10:00–12:00 (fit for Day 1: overview + API deep-dive)
- Wed Jun 23: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00 (fit for Day 2 lab)

If you'd prefer two contiguous blocks for your folks, we can also book 2.5 hour contiguous slots on a single day but that increases fatigue.

Looping in Soojin for network setup (she will run a short connectivity preflight). Jordan will serve as lead instructor for the lab. I'll send calendar proposals after you confirm preferences.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive — Platform
Redwood Inference

- Day 2 (live lab): Wed Jun 23, 09:00–10:30 CEST (05:00–06:30 EST) — this is early for NYC; can we shift lab to 14:00 CEST if that works for your instructors?

We also need confirmation on:
- Exact list of participant emails for sandbox provisioning
